productLaunches.title: ZooWork
productLaunches.description: The AI agent delivery platform for FDEs and domain experts - ZooWork lets you build, deploy, and deliver AI agents to teams or clients — experts start in the Builder UI, developers ship with the Managed Agent API. Turn your expertise into AI solutions built for real business operations.

productLaunches.title: miso.com
productLaunches.description: Book flights and hotels through iMessage - Stop opening 20 tabs to book a trip. Miso is an AI travel agent in iMessage that finds, books, and manages flights and hotels for you. Just text where you want to go and Miso searches live options, learns your travel preferences, and handles the booking in the same conversation. With direct airline access and 24/7 support, you can go from “I need to be in London Tuesday” to booked without leaving Messages.

productLaunches.title: Cubicle
productLaunches.description: A live office for your AI agents, read-only by design - Watch Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Paperclip agents work in a live office: they sit down and type, raise a hand or line up at your desk when they need you, and go to the lounge when done. KPI board for your tasks, Telegram alerts with the agent's questions, phone view, pixel or HD themes, real faces, your logo. One command (npx), zero dependencies, MIT. Read-only by design: it only watches; the one optional write is your own Telegram reply, posted as a comment.

productLaunches.title: Muse Gadgets
productLaunches.description: Meta's open-source kit for building your own AI gadgets - Muse Gadgets is Meta's open-source hardware toolkit for bringing Muse into the physical world. Connect an ESP32, Raspberry Pi, or Linux device to displays, microphones, speakers, buttons, sensors, and more, then let Muse interact through the hardware you build. Make a pocket AI companion, e-ink briefing display, smart-home controller, TV interface, or something entirely your own. SDKs and firmware are open source under Apache 2.0.

productLaunches.title: SCMD
productLaunches.description: Manage what Claude Remembers and Keeps as Memory. - Claude only! SCMD is an open-source, local review deck for the persistent memories Claude Code saves about you and your projects. Keep, delete, skip, undo, rewrite, and inspect why a memory was saved. Decisions stay staged until you confirm; deletes go to restorable trash. No telemetry, no cloud service, and zero npm dependencies. Run it with /scmd:run or npx. MIT-licensed and ready for contributors.

MIT-licensed and ready for contributors.
